title: Prison School
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Five boys are among the first male students admitted to a strict former girls' academy. Caught peeping into the girls' bath, they are locked in the school's own prison block and punished by the Underground Student Council, whose members treat them harshly. The series is a raunchy farce built on their escape plots and power struggles with the council.
life_message: It holds up loyalty among friends and the pursuit of desire, treated as comedy, against arbitrary power.

content.note: Whipping, kicking and brutal slapstick abuse of the boys by female guards; AIPT found it more unsettling than funny (Manga Revue; AIPT).
Played for comedy; humiliation and tension rather than fear (Wikipedia; reviews).
Frequent nudity and close-up crotch and breast shots, voyeurism, fetish and masochism, no actual sex; rated M 18+ (Manga Revue; AIPT; AniList Nudity 82%, Femdom 80%; MangaDex erotica).
Crude sexual talk throughout; profanity level not stated in reviews (to verify).
Public humiliation, a show trial and bullying played for laughs (Manga Revue; AniList Bullying 72%); depth not stated (to verify).
Peeping on classmates drives the plot, plus crude bodily humor such as urinating on a guard (Wikipedia; AIPT).
Anime and live-action adaptations; no in-story product focus.

delivery.evidence: No source comments on delivery; summaries show the outlook carried by plot and character choices (to verify).
delivery.note: Its outlook is delivered through farce, mocking both the boys' appetites and the council's power.

winners_losers: Both the lecherous boys and the domineering council are mocked, but the boys' loyalty to each other earns the most sympathy. Authority figures are shown as arbitrary and the comedy rewards appetite.
